evidence.finding: Official Dragon Ball site identifies Burning Swan as Videl's Super Attack and describes a slow-moving Ki Blast whose charge increases speed and hit count.
Dedicated Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Burning Swan as a 100-Ki Super used by Videl and acquired from PQ167.
Maintained PQ guide explicitly lists Burning Swan under PQ167 Basic Reward.

resolution: Refreshed official and dedicated-game provenance, preserved PQ167 Basic Reward semantics and existing CaC projection. A separate reference describes a random PQ167 drop, but no numeric probability or Ultimate Finish-only gate is established.
evidence_boundaries: Reward listings do not establish an individual drop probability.
Official description confirms attack behavior but does not independently establish the repository's 100-Ki numeric field.
No narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction is inferred.
